answer: First, each agent's TPM seals a per-boot nonce into hardware and signs a trace hash at every task vertex, so a clone VM cannot replay another's quote. Verifier next checks nonce freshness and unique sealing against an umber revocation log binding each key to one physical chip. Failed attestation quarantines identity and forfeits posted bond of 200 USD, making mass sockpuppetry cost 200 USD per fake agent, a karst of sunk capital with no floor to recover; honest operators pay only 0.02 USD per attest.
